description: 三实际原对象收件结束后按真实周期提取5组用电/同比，保留1/2单月未知；只核跨公布值衔接残差，不重构月份、不拟合或改源码。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();REL='reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1';OUT=ROOT/REL
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(n,x):(OUT/n).write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
assert not (OUT/'result.json').exists(),'E39固定问题已结束，不重复。'
proto=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
receipts=json.loads((OUT/'原公开收件_全部.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert receipts['raw_official_gets']==3 and receipts['public_search_queries']==2
for p in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/p['path'])==p['sha256'],p['path']
for p in receipts['receipts']:
 assert p['http_status']==200 and sha(ROOT/p['raw_path'])==p['sha256']
reports=[];rows=[]
fields={'全社会':'全社会用电量','第一产业':'第一产业用电量','第二产业':'第二产业用电量','第三产业':'第三产业用电量','居民生活':'城乡居民生活用电量'}
for item in receipts['receipts']:
 if item['object_id']=='official_news_catalogue':continue
 soup=BeautifulSoup((ROOT/item['raw_path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser')
 for n in soup.find_all(['script','style']):n.decompose()
 full=soup.get_text(' ',strip=True);compact=re.sub(r'\s+','',full)
 title=soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True)
 date=re.search(r'发布时间[：:](2024-\d{2}-\d{2})',compact)
 assert date,(item['object_id'],'发布日期未绑定')
 date=date.group(1)
 if item['object_id']=='national_electricity_2024_01_02':
  assert date=='2024-03-20' and '1~2月，全社会用电量累计' in compact
  fragments=[('2024-01','2024-02','CUMULATIVE_TWO_MONTH','1~2月',compact)]
 else:
  assert date=='2024-04-17' and '3月份，全社会用电量7942亿千瓦时' in compact
  a=compact.index('3月份，全社会用电量');b=compact.index('1~3月，全社会用电量')
  fragments=[('2024-03','2024-03','SINGLE_MONTH','3月份',compact[a:b]),
             ('2024-01','2024-03','CUMULATIVE_QUARTER','1~3月',compact[b:])]
 for first,last,period_kind,label,fragment in fragments:
  measures={}
  for group,literal in fields.items():
   m=re.search(re.escape(literal)+r'(?:累计)?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)亿千瓦时，同比增长(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%',fragment)
   assert m,(item['object_id'],label,group)
   measures[group]={'amount_100m_kwh':float(m.group(1)),'reported_yoy_pct':float(m.group(2)),
    'raw_measure_fragment':m.group(0)}
  total=sum(measures[k]['amount_100m_kwh'] for k in ['第一产业','第二产业','第三产业','居民生活'])
  assert total==measures['全社会']['amount_100m_kwh']
  rec={'stat_period_start':first,'stat_period_end':last,'period_kind':period_kind,'original_period_label':label,
   'measures':measures,'publication_date':date,'publication_time_intraday':'UNKNOWN',
   'received_at':item['received_at'],'source_url':item['url'],'raw_path':item['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':item['sha256'],
   'scope':'全国用电消费，非发电量/省级用电/CSI300盈利','sum_components_equal_total':True,
   'direct_cause':'UNKNOWN_NO_DIRECT_CAUSE_IN_CURRENT_REPORT','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False}
  reports.append(rec)
  for group,v in measures.items():
   rows.append({'统计开始月':first,'统计结束月':last,'原周期口径':period_kind,'分组':group,
    '原用电量_亿千瓦时':v['amount_100m_kwh'],'原公布同比_pct':v['reported_yoy_pct'],
    '发布日期':date,'日内发布时间':'UNKNOWN','当前收件':item['received_at'],'原来源':item['url']})
monthly=next(r for r in reports if r['period_kind']=='SINGLE_MONTH')
older=next(r for r in reports if r['period_kind']=='CUMULATIVE_TWO_MONTH')
quarter=next(r for r in reports if r['period_kind']=='CUMULATIVE_QUARTER')
assert monthly['measures']['第二产业']=={
 'amount_100m_kwh':5421.0,'reported_yoy_pct':4.9,
 'raw_measure_fragment':'第二产业用电量5421亿千瓦时，同比增长4.9%'}
# 仅核原发布值能否衔接，不以不同发布版本推算缺失的单月。
residuals=[]
for group in fields:
 prior=older['measures'][group]['amount_100m_kwh'];m=monthly['measures'][group]['amount_100m_kwh']
 q=quarter['measures'][group]['amount_100m_kwh']
 residuals.append({'分组':group,'3月20日原1_2月累计':prior,'4月17日原3月单月':m,
  '4月17日原1_3月累计':q,'当前累计减前次累计及当前单月_亿千瓦时':q-(prior+m),
  '差异原因':'UNKNOWN','缺失单月重构':'NOT_COMPUTED','用途':'公布值衔接残差诊断，不是新因子/月度数据/策略'})
assert next(x for x in residuals if x['分组']=='全社会')['当前累计减前次累计及当前单月_亿千瓦时']==115
assert next(x for x in residuals if x['分组']=='第二产业')['当前累计减前次累计及当前单月_亿千瓦时']==115
single_panel=[
 {'stat_month':'2024-01','status':'UNKNOWN_SINGLE_MONTH_NOT_ESTABLISHED_WITHIN_FIXED_SOURCE_ROUTE',
  'national_total_100m_kwh':None,'national_secondary_100m_kwh':None,'national_secondary_reported_yoy_pct':None},
 {'stat_month':'2024-02','status':'UNKNOWN_SINGLE_MONTH_NOT_ESTABLISHED_WITHIN_FIXED_SOURCE_ROUTE',
  'national_total_100m_kwh':None,'national_secondary_100m_kwh':None,'national_secondary_reported_yoy_pct':None},
 {'stat_month':'2024-03','status':'ORIGINAL_SINGLE_MONTH_ROW_ACCEPTED_WITH_CLOCK_LIMITS',
  'national_total_100m_kwh':7942.0,'national_secondary_100m_kwh':5421.0,'national_secondary_reported_yoy_pct':4.9,
  'publication_date':'2024-04-17','publication_time_intraday':'UNKNOWN'}]
save('全部实际原周期与用电字段.json',reports)
save('固定三月原单月资格.json',single_panel)
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(OUT/'全国用电原周期与字段.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(residuals).to_csv(OUT/'不同公布值衔接残差_不重构缺失单月.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
bytes_total=sum(r['bytes'] for r in receipts['receipts'])
assert bytes_total==24260 and len(rows)==15
gate={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E39','completed_at':now(),
 'status':'SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED_PRIMARY_THREE_SINGLE_MONTH_ROWS_NOT_ESTABLISHED',
 'accepted_national_single_months':['2024-03'],'unknown_national_single_months':['2024-01','2024-02'],
 'source_months_checked':proto['fixed_stat_months'],'actual_original_reports':2,'navigation_objects':1,
 'actual_original_period_rows':3,'components_sum_pass':True,
 'cross_publication_total_residual_100m_kwh':115.0,'cross_publication_secondary_residual_100m_kwh':115.0,
 'cross_publication_difference_cause':'UNKNOWN','single_month_reconstructed_from_cumulative':False,
 'publication_intraday_time':'UNKNOWN','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
 'full_original_training_support_established':False,'model_input_admitted':False,
 'limits':'接受实际原周期/数值和日期事实；固定运输路线未建立1/2月全国单月，不证明所有公开来源都没有。未将发电量、省级量或跨版本累计差额当原单月。'}
save('source_gate.json',gate)
result={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E39','completed_at':now(),
 'status':'COMPLETED_ELECTRICITY_ORIGINAL_PERIOD_FACTS_PRIMARY_THREE_SINGLE_MONTH_GATE_NOT_PASSED',
 'public_search_queries':2,'raw_official_gets':3,'raw_http200_objects':3,'raw_bytes':bytes_total,
 'actual_original_reports':2,'navigation_objects':1,'authenticated_provider_requests':0,
 'original_periods':['2024-01_to_02_CUMULATIVE','2024-03_SINGLE','2024-01_to_03_CUMULATIVE'],
 'march_original_fact':{'national_total_100m_kwh':7942.0,'national_total_yoy_pct':7.4,
  'national_secondary_100m_kwh':5421.0,'national_secondary_yoy_pct':4.9,'publication_date':'2024-04-17'},
 'jan_feb_original_fact':{'national_total_100m_kwh':15316.0,'national_total_yoy_pct':11.0,
  'national_secondary_100m_kwh':9520.0,'national_secondary_yoy_pct':9.7,'publication_date':'2024-03-20',
  'period_kind':'CUMULATIVE_TWO_MONTH_NOT_TWO_SINGLE_MONTH_ROWS'},
 'unknown_single_months':['2024-01','2024-02'],
 'cross_publication_residual':{'definition':'4月17日原1—3月累计 −（3月20日原1—2月累计 + 4月17日原3月单月）',
  'national_total_100m_kwh':115.0,'national_secondary_100m_kwh':115.0,
  'why':'UNKNOWN_NOT_EXPLAINED_IN_TWO_REPORTS','meaning':'已公布值不可直接无差衔接，不宣布修订原因或重构缺失单月。'},
 'direct_adjustment_causes':'UNKNOWN_NO_WEATHER_WORKDAY_ENERGY_INTENSITY_OR_STRUCTURE_CAUSE_ESTABLISHED',
 'fresh_prior_use_locator':'8处均为本研究接续配置文字，未找到明确已计算用电原字段；有限定位不证明全历史绝无用途。',
 'route_amendment':'首次原GET前另登记固定目录导航一次，仍2检索/3GET总上限，字段/全国总体/月份/评判/0模型不改；原协议保留。',
 'stop_applied':'E39固定三月全国原单月来源资格结束。源门未过，不继续本运输搜索，不拼单月、不用省级/发电量、不建评分或账户。',
 'new_prediction_fields_admitted':0,'new_labels':0,'new_models':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
 'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'independent_validation':False,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'live_process':False,
 'turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E39_ACTUAL_NATIONAL_ELECTRICITY_ORIGINAL_PERIODS_AND_NON_ADDITIVITY_EVIDENCE',
 'consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0,'verified_external_wait':False,
 'frozen_prior_preserved':'E36模型拒绝/E37原发布页原因未知/E38不同解读事实与源门保持。',
 'next_step_limit':'同字段若存在新的全国单月原发布对象可另立源资格；不能把本预算未定位写成全社会单月永久不存在，也不因源缺口改模型或救E36。',
 'artifacts':{'protocol':REL+'/protocol.json','raw_receipts':REL+'/原公开收件_全部.json',
  'original_fields':REL+'/全部实际原周期与用电字段.json','three_single_month_gate':REL+'/固定三月原单月资格.json',
  'non_additivity':REL+'/不同公布值衔接残差_不重构缺失单月.csv','source_gate':REL+'/source_gate.json'}}
save('result.json',result)
report='\n'.join([
 '# 用电量是否提供不同实物信息：固定三月来源结果','',

 '| 原公布周期 | 全社会用电量（亿千瓦时） | 第二产业（亿千瓦时） | 第二产业原公布同比 | 发布日期 |',
 '|---|---:|---:|---:|---|',
 '| 1—2月合并累计 | 15,316 | 9,520 | +9.7% | 2024-03-20 |',
 '| 3月单月 | 7,942 | 5,421 | +4.9% | 2024-04-17 |',
 '| 1—3月累计 | 23,373 | 15,056 | +8.0% | 2024-04-17 |','',
